elayah.name: Elayah Lorethain
elayah.blurb: You strength lies in your softness and how much you care for other people. Don't let others underestimate you, for when someone messes with your loved ones they are playing a dangerous game.

rayn.name: Rayn Varcas
rayn.blurb: You are a soft soul with a thick shell. To many you might seem heartless, but you will fight ferously for those who saw past your walls and have won your trust.
